description: Trade-off between distributional alignment and behavioural-embedding preservation, 5-fold cross-validated
finding: Without behavioural regularisation (lambda_b=0) the calibrator achieves the lowest JS but cosine similarity drops to 0.76, below the 0.80 acceptance threshold — unconstrained calibration destroys behavioural structure. lambda_b=0.3 preserves cosine at 0.84 while keeping JS well within bounds, and shows the lowest cross-validation variance.
